headline: Logitech G launches Blue Yeti 2 mic with AI noise reduction and voice sensor
summary: The successor to the iconic Blue Yeti USB mic features AI-powered noise removal and a new voice sensor that automatically adjusts gain and EQ.
details: The original Blue Yeti, launched in 2009, has been a staple for content creators. Its successor, the Blue Yeti 2, is now available under the Logitech G brand, bringing modern upgrades like an interactive LED display, AI de-noising, and a proximity-based voice sensor.

Priced at $159.99, the Blue Yeti 2 is available in black and white. This positions it competitively against Shure's MV7 series, which starts at $299, and is only $10 more than the original Blue Yeti's launch price 17 years ago.

A key feature is the built-in audio proximity sensor. It tracks voice in 3D and automatically adjusts gain, EQ, and pickup patterns to maintain recording quality, regardless of the user's distance from the mic. This aims to make it more beginner-friendly than its predecessor.

The microphone offers high-resolution capture up to 24-bit / 48 kHz. It also includes integrated direct digital signal processing (DSP) for enhanced voice clarity without extra software, and AI-powered noise removal to cut down background distractions like computer fans and mouse clicks.

Designed for streamers, the Yeti 2 features a 1.3-inch color LED display on the front. This display provides visual feedback on gain levels and polar patterns, even showing a "Yeti character" for a touch of personality.
